title: TipDex-VTLA: Learning When to Refine Actions with Touch for Dexterous Manipulation
abstract: arXiv:2611.25683v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Changes in illumination can induce action drift in dexterous manipulation even when the physical state remains unchanged. Although existing vision--tactile--language--action (VTLA) policies incorporate tactile feedback, when and how touch refines actions under changing visual conditions remains challenging. We introduce \textbf{TipDex-VTLA}, a VTLA policy that combines estimated visual action reliability and tactile forecast verification to regulate execution-time refinement. Specifically, Visual Action Sensitivity Estimation (VASE) learns visual reliability from a frozen reference policy's action sensitivity to illumination perturbations. Tactile Anticipation and Correction during Execution (TACE) compares predicted and measured touch at matched times and combines the resulting discrepancy with visual reliability to gate bounded feature corrections for unexecuted actions. translated_title: TipDex-VTLA：学习在灵巧操作中何时利用触觉精修动作
translated_abstract: 即使物理状态保持不变，光照变化也会在灵巧操作中引发动作漂移。尽管现有的视觉-触觉-语言-动作（VTLA）策略已融入触觉反馈，但在视觉条件变化时，触觉何时以及如何精修动作仍然是一个具有挑战性的问题。我们提出 TipDex-VTLA，一种结合估计的视觉动作可靠性与触觉预测校验来调控执行时精修的 VTLA 策略。具体而言，视觉动作敏感性估计（VASE）从冻结的参考策略对光照扰动的动作敏感性中学习视觉可靠性；执行过程中的触觉预期与校正（TACE）在匹配时刻比较预测触觉与实测触觉，并将由此产生的差异与视觉可靠性相结合，为尚未执行的动作进行有界的特征校正门控。这有效地帮助在具有挑战性的未见条件下精修动作（注：原文摘要在此处截断）。
tldr: 提出 TipDex-VTLA 策略，将基于冻结参考策略光照敏感性的视觉动作可靠性估计（VASE）与执行期触觉预测校验（TACE）相结合，动态决定何时及如何对未执行动作施加有界的触觉校正，从而抑制光照变化引起的灵巧操作动作漂移。
en_tdlr: TipDex-VTLA combines visual action reliability estimation (learned from a frozen reference policy's sensitivity to illumination perturbations) with execution-time tactile forecast verification to decide when and how to gate bounded touch-based corrections on unexecuted actions, mitigating illumination-induced action drift in dexterous manipulation.
